newsitem.title: USA: New Hampshire governor declares state of emergency.
newsitem.headline: New Hampshire governor declares state of emergency.

text.p: New Hampshire Governor Stephen Merrill late Monday declared a state of emergency for the entire state after a fierce storm dumped record amounts of rain.
The storm, which has lashed the Northeast for three days, caused rivers and lakes to overflow their banks, flooding homes and highways.
While the storm continues to pound Maine and is expected to move into Canada, flash flood warnings remain in effect throughout much of New England.
Both Massachusetts and Maine have declared limited states of emergency for their flood-ravaged coastal counties.
